channel.title: UAE Free Zone AI Watch
channel.description: AI deals, adoption and launches announced by UAE free zones

item.title: [Masdar City Free Zone] US-based Brain Digits opens office in Masdar City to build AI solutions for the UAE and GCC
item.description: The office will develop AI solutions for the UAE market as Abu Dhabi pushes to become an AI-native government.

item.title: [Innovation City (RAK)] Innovation City launches AI-agent company registration built on Salesforce Agentforce
item.description: AI agents now handle company registration end to end, turning a process of days or weeks into minutes, with human review only for exceptions.

item.title: [Dubai Silicon Oasis] RTA opens Dubai Mobility Labs at Dubai Silicon Oasis with 248 autonomous-vehicle test scenarios
item.description: A testing and certification facility for autonomous mobility in Dubai Silicon Oasis, combining controlled scenarios with public-road trials; DEKRA operates it for three years.

item.title: [Dubai Internet City] SAP and Dubai Internet City convene women leaders on building the UAE's AI-ready workforce
item.description: An executive panel and youth circle at Dubai Internet City on AI and women's careers in technology, part of Emirati Women's Day.

item.title: [DIFC] 'SHE Leads with AI': Dubai AI Campus launches its first female-founder accelerator at DIFC Innovation Hub
item.description: A six-day programme with fully funded places for 30 women founders, delivered at DIFC Innovation Hub with an investor showcase; it starts 16 November 2026.

item.title: [ADGM] ADGM completes phase one of in-house AI rollout: 25 business functions, 5,000+ staff hours saved a year, AED 400m roadmap to 2029
item.description: ADGM deployed AI across licensing, supervision and customer service; about 25% of customer enquiries are now resolved instantly, and it will invest more than AED 400m in AI, data and cyber capabilities to 2029.

item.title: [ADGM] ADGM Academy launches WMI School of AI, training 544 UAE Nationals in agentic AI
item.description: Part of ADGM Academy's H1 2026 output of 1,607 Emiratis trained; the agentic-AI school targets the wealth-management sector.

item.title: [ADGM] ADGM entities now hold more than USD 100bn in AI-focused investment, anchored by FSRA-licensed MGX
item.description: Reported alongside 54% AUM growth in H1 2026; ADGM describes itself as the jurisdiction of choice for institutions deploying capital into AI.

item.title: [Sharjah Media City (Shams)] Shams AI Club trains 300+ professionals from 16 government entities; programmes run to end of October
item.description: The first phase targets 500 participants with training on prompt engineering, automation, data analysis and responsible AI.

item.title: [Sharjah Publishing City Free Zone] Sharjah Publishing City Free Zone passes 1,000 AI-related companies
item.description: More than 1,000 AI-related companies now operate in SPC Free Zone, which also runs an AI-powered licensing system; company formation packages start from AED 5,750.

item.title: [Dubai Science Park] Longevium raises USD 7m and builds AI-powered longevity research lab in Dubai Science Park
item.description: The lab, due to open in Q4 2026, will use AI to assess biological age, detect disease early and build patient digital twins.

item.title: [DIFC] DIFC: AI, FinTech and innovation firms up 39% to 1,933 in H1 2026
item.description: DIFC's H1 2026 results: the Innovation Hub added 361 companies, taking AI, FinTech and innovation firms to 1,933; DIFC restated its AI-Native centre plan (USD 3.5bn value, 25,000 jobs).

item.title: [Innovation City (RAK)] UK PC maker Chillblast sets up GCC base in Innovation City Ras Al Khaimah for AI and gaming systems
item.description: Chillblast's high-performance AI and gaming systems will be supported from its new regional base in Innovation City.

item.title: [Expo City Dubai, DIFC] Nestle opens AI-powered SparX Innovation Hub at its new head office in Expo City Dubai
item.description: The hub uses AI and data to spot consumer opportunities and speed up product development, drawing on Nestle's strategic partnership with the DIFC AI Campus.

item.title: [Innovation City (RAK)] Innovation City (RAK) and Siada launch the Middle East's first sovereign AI data centre with NVIDIA B200 GPUs
item.description: Licensed companies can rent sovereign GPU compute by the hour, reserve capacity or run fully managed environments, with data kept in the UAE.

item.title: [Innovation City (RAK)] Sumsub partners with Innovation City to expand identity-verification and compliance services
item.description: RegTech company Sumsub partnered with Innovation City, the Ras Al Khaimah free zone for AI and digital businesses, on verification and compliance technology for its companies.

item.title: [Dubai Silicon Oasis] First enterprise IT hardware manufacturing unit in the UAE opens at Dubai Silicon Oasis
item.description: KERNO Enterprises, the first manufacturer of enterprise IT hardware in the UAE, opened its unit in Dubai Silicon Oasis, supporting the national push on AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing.

item.title: [DIFC] DIFC launches consultation on amended Data Protection Regulations with new AI-related safeguards
item.description: Proposed amendments strengthen governance and accountability for systems that process personal data, with specific safeguards for AI-driven processing.

item.title: [DIFC] DIFC Future of Finance report: AI-driven challenger banks reshape the industry; banks risk losing USD 170bn in profits by 2030
item.description: DIFC's research report argues banks need AI-led operating models, estimating up to USD 170bn in profits at risk by 2030.

item.title: [Hub71, ADGM] Emirati founders unveil AI-powered solutions at Hub71 Impact 2026
item.description: Hub71's showcase featured Emirati start-ups applying AI in marketing, healthcare and advanced manufacturing.

item.title: [Hub71, ADGM] Mastercard Lighthouse and Hub71 open UAE AI start-up programme
item.description: A four-month programme for start-ups using AI in financial services, commerce, risk and MSME solutions, run under the Mastercard UAE AI Center of Excellence with the UAE AI Office.

item.title: [DIFC] Positron AI opens its first office outside the US in DIFC
item.description: US AI-inference hardware maker Positron AI, which has raised more than USD 300m, chose DIFC for its first international office.

item.title: [DWTC Free Zone] Zand and DWTC Free Zone form strategic alliance to deliver AI- and blockchain-powered banking to free zone businesses
item.description: The alliance offers Zand's AI and blockchain-powered digital banking services to more than 2,500 DWTC Free Zone businesses under Dubai's D33 agenda.

item.title: [KEZAD] ROX signs lease for one of the Middle East's first advanced AI manufacturing centres in KEZAD Musaffah
item.description: A 10,000 sqm intelligent manufacturing facility starting operations in H2 2026, targeting 300,000 vehicles a year by 2030.

item.title: [Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai CommerCity] DIEZ and VOLT UAE to build AI-ready data centre ('AI factory') in Dubai Silicon Oasis
item.description: Joint venture for a facility of up to 60,000 sqm: an initial 29 MW followed by 100 MW of committed power. DIEZ provides land and core infrastructure; VOLT develops, finances and operates; Schneider Electric supplies power systems.

item.title: [DIFC] DIFC to become the world's first AI-Native financial centre
item.description: AI to be embedded across DIFC's legal and regulatory frameworks, business operations, talent systems, infrastructure and physical district, with a stated USD 3.5bn (AED 12.9bn) economic benefit and 25,000 jobs; plans include a full-stack AI Campus (regulation, training, compute, physical AI) and robotics and digital twins across the district by 2030.

item.title: [ADGM] World Alliance of International Financial Centers and ADGM release 2026 report on AI in financial services
item.description: The report finds AI adoption embedded across international financial centres, with widespread use in compliance, fraud detection and client services.

item.title: [Dubai CommerCity] IIT Madras Global to establish its first Applied AI Innovation Centre at Dubai CommerCity
item.description: MoU signed at WORLDEF Dubai (12-14 Feb). The centre's first phase hosts six applied-AI start-ups with a combined valuation of about USD 118m, targeting smart cities, energy, logistics and construction.

item.title: [Hub71, ADGM] Fikra Ventures partners with Hub71 to build and scale AI-native companies from Abu Dhabi
item.description: The partnership pairs Hub71's founder ecosystem with Fikra Ventures' venture-studio platform to create and scale AI-native companies in Abu Dhabi.
